scope: RealText extraction, attributes, lowercase assembly, time folding and tag rendering are owned safe Rust under the checked document registry.

operations.behavior: Owned input, output tag, cursor, flag patches, text extraction and partial attribute state use existing safe leaf state machines directly. Prefix consumption, comment-at-end failure, permissive mismatched quotes/slashes, repeated case-folded attributes and partial commits retain reference behavior. No native tag/list/string pointer or raw helper handle enters the engine.

Each raw u16 goes to the native towlower callback and returns a checked u16. Attributes remain sorted by raw code units and later equal folded keys replace earlier values. There is no Rust Unicode scalar normalization or lossy decoding.

Reverse field extraction, fractional right-padding and multiplier updates are Rust-owned. Each detached field retains native _wtoi conversion, then signed i32 multiplication/addition wrap explicitly. Long fields and more than three separators are covered directly against the cleanup.

Rust iterates ordered tags/attributes and builds raw UTF16 output. It preserves fresh CRealTextParser defaults: duration4000ms, no font ignore flags, minimum14/maximum25, permissive parsing. Only nonempty size attributes request iswdigit, then _wtoi if numeric; original filtering retains zero and negative/nonnumeric size text. Formatting-only output remains empty.

The engine drives the prior owned parser session and helpers until a native scalar/file/Add service is needed. Native callbacks run after registry admission ends. Input is immutable across helper callbacks. Bounds-fault requests preserve the original checked std::wstring access; exception compatibility is not established by these finite tests.

OpenRealText uses the checked session directly, without constructing CRealTextParser or calling its extraction/time/render methods. Native services are ReadString, CString whitespace/CompareNoCase, iswspace/towlower/_wtoi/iswdigit, final SubRipper2SSA and Add. Final c_str truncation remains at the original export boundary.

boundary_review.retired_private_protocol: Six RealText v1 static-library entries, including arbitrary extraction/render packets, are replaced by five v2 entries. These are internal, not public DLL exports.
boundary_review.contract: Typed never-reused document-bound IDs; nonblocking registry admission; bounded copied UTF16LE/strict-bool spaces; scalar command must equal pending op; bools0/1, lower0..65535, Add ack0; output preflight; immutable snapshots outlive run and parent. Group0: op/accepted:u32,start/end:i64,unit/index:u32,raw payload. Groups1..3 preserve tag/map/window snapshots.
boundary_review.tests: Caller-buffer mutation, unpaired surrogate, malformed input lengths/flags, strict scalar replies, wrong phase/kind, BUSY, output capacity, parent destruction, stale IDs, detached map/input/emission snapshots; core tests for duplicate folded attributes, size filtering, formatting restore, wrapping time fold and trailing-text/comment failure.

direct_probe.method: Actual OpenRealText and initialized document observer; two reference and two candidate executions per architecture. Full state/outcome/byte-position traces must match and be stable. Valid baseline and post-engine traces are byte-identical.
direct_probe.new_coverage: 600 cases added to the retained 3932-case prefix: duplicate/case-folded attributes, size boundaries, raw surrogates, Unicode unit predicates, mismatched quotes, slash termination, missing equals, unterminated values and long time fields.
direct_probe.baseline_harness_correction: Commit20c4a784 used a forbidden C++ universal-character surrogate literal and did not compile. Commit248e9b15 uses a raw hex code-unit escape; only its successfully executed baseline is parity evidence.

limits: Experimental document path only; no production switch, RealText format closure or full-library completion.

ReadString/CString trimming and comparison, CRT character predicates/case/integer conversion, SubRipper2SSA and Add remain native services. All C++ host adapters and fallback raw RealText APIs remain transitional and in scope.

Finite Windows MSVC 14.44 x86/x64 evidence against the pinned cleanup. No allocation failure/reentry, file-I/O fault injection, locale mutation or bounds-exception parity claim; no Miri or non-Windows whole-renderer evidence.
SubViewer missing-style outcomes remain unresolved as recorded in rust-subviewer-reference-outcomes.json. This increment neither changes its fallback nor selects arbitrary defaults.
Crashes, hangs and nondeterminism are unresolved, never equality. Remaining formats, renderer, all public hosts and vendored code remain part of the full migration.
